#en: No one built this pod to be found; it sits deep under regolith and rock, humming quietly against the planet's pulse, its consoles still listening to channels the UC pretends it shut down years ago. If any place would log a ghost crossing into restricted space, it is here, in the blind spot between sanctioned feeds and forgotten operations. The analyst who ran from this post knew enough to be afraid, but not enough to see how routine crossings and familiar callsigns had dulled their edge while someone slipped an unauthorized asset through the cracks. So far the trail is a frightened preacher's stories from a remote retreat, half corrupted schematics scraped from a lonely cache, and now a classified file that finally admits our fugitive once moved under official cover, right where no one was supposed to be watching too closely.
zh: 没人把这个监控舱造成会被发现的；它深埋在风化层与岩石之下，贴着行星的脉搏轻轻嗡鸣，控制台仍在聆听联殖假装多年前就关闭的频道。若说有什么地方会记录下一次"幽灵穿越受限太空"，那就是这里，在获批数据流与被遗忘行动之间的盲点里。从这个岗位逃走的那名分析员知道的东西够多到足以害怕，却不够多到看清：当有人把一件未授权资产从缝隙里溜过去时，那些例行穿越与熟悉的呼号是如何让他们失去了警觉。目前为止，这条线索是某名受惊传教士在偏远隐居地讲的故事、从一处孤独储藏点刮来的半损坏图纸，如今又是一份机密文件——它终于承认我们的逃犯曾以官方身份移动，恰恰在没人该盯得太近的地方。

#en: Down in Neon's lowest decks, under flickering grid-light and dripping coolant, records go to be forgotten rather than erased. This is where overworked techs and off-book captains stash the things that look too small to matter: misfiled service orders, unsigned firmware notes, a recall draft that never quite became official. If there is a place where the story was written plainly, then quietly buried under bad lighting and Aurora haze, it is here, between scavenged panels and repurposed junction boxes. Every step so far has been like that: a half-corroborated ping from a lonely shack, a freighter whose drive history did not match its manifest, a dead ship carrying a manifest that bent routes by a few innocent degrees, each hint straightforward on paper yet strangely slippery when you try to hold the whole pattern in your hands.
zh: 在霓虹城最底层的甲板，在闪烁的网格灯光与滴落的冷却液之下，记录是去被遗忘、而非被抹除的。这里正是超负荷工作的技师与账外船长藏起那些"看起来太小、不值一提"的东西的地方：归档错误的服务单、未签名的固件备注、一份从未正式成形的召回草稿。若说有一个故事曾被平白写下、然后悄悄埋在糟糕灯光与极光雾气之下的地方，那就是这里，在拾来的面板与被改作他用的接线盒之间。目前为止的每一步都是这样：一座孤独棚屋传来半被证实的脉冲、一艘引擎履历与舱单不符的货船、一艘载着把航线掰偏了几度——"几度无辜"——的舱单的死船，每一处线索在纸面上都直白，可当你试图把整个模式握在手里时，却奇怪地滑不留手。

#en: Out here, anchored beside a lonely beacon in high orbit, the sky itself is the archive. This is where he would tune his quiet corrections, nudging satellites and survey nets until entire worlds saw false trajectories as truth. The calibration data that slips through this node never touches official channels; it rides on test pings and maintenance checks, the kind of traffic no one audits until something falls out of the sky. Back on that forgotten rock, farmers only whispered about storms that learned new paths; at the abandoned relay, warning signals died mid-sentence; in the dead lab, grav experiments were left half-scrubbed. Every fragment has come secondhand, traded between people who insist they do not know the whole story, yet all their half-told versions curve the same way, toward an unseen hand repositioning the stars.
zh: 在这里，锚定在高轨道上一座孤独信标旁，天空本身就是档案。这里是他会调校自己那些安静修正的地方，把卫星与勘探网一路推到整个世界都把虚假轨迹当作真相。从这个节点溜过的校准数据从不接触官方信道；它乘着测试脉冲与维护检查，那种直到有东西从天上掉下来才有人审计的交通。回到那块被遗忘的岩石，农场主只低声议论学会了新路径的风暴；在那座废弃中继，警告信号在句子中间死去；在那座死掉的实验室，引力实验被半途抹除。每一块碎片都是二手的，在坚称自己不知道全貌的人之间转手，可他们那些半截版本全都朝同一方向弯曲——指向一只重新摆放星辰的无形之手。

#en: HM-7378 drifts like a sealed question in UC livery, its running lights cold but its transponder still dutifully pinging into a void no one answers anymore. If there is anywhere a buried set of routing orders might still be ticking over on autopilot, it is inside a forgotten SysDef hull whose crew never lived long enough to shut anything down properly. The silence feels procedural rather than abandoned, like a ward left prepped for patients who never arrived, systems still waiting on triggers written by officers who are now dust.  \nSo far I have chased fragments: an anonymous slate on a distant rock, a ghost signal in high orbit, hints of diverted evac flights and scrubbed medical logs, all suggesting that whatever directive turned a good medic into a roaming clinic is still active in the background, following its own schedule.
zh: HM-7378像一枚封着的问号漂着，涂着联殖涂装，航行灯冰冷，应答器却仍尽职地朝一个再无人应答的虚空发出脉冲。若说有一套被埋的航线路由命令可能仍在自动驾驶下滴答运行，那就是在某具被遗忘的星防队船壳里——它的船员活得不够久，没能把任何东西妥善关掉。那份寂静感觉像程序性的，而非被遗弃的，像一间已为从未抵达的病人备好的病房，系统仍在等着那些如今已成尘土的军官写下的触发条件。  \n目前为止，我一直在追碎片：遥远岩石上一块匿名数据板、高轨道上一道幽灵信号、关于被改道撤离飞行与被擦净医疗日志的暗示，全都指向：那道把一名好医疗兵变成流浪诊所的指令，仍在后台按它自己的日程运行。

#en: Out here in quiet orbit, the thing humming against the black is less a beacon than a scar in the traffic lanes, a slow, deliberate kink in how ships choose their jumps. It was never meant to exist this close to settled space; layer by layer someone bent the routes around it, until captains began to follow a curve they could not see. Left alone, it keeps teaching drives to lean toward the same blind corner of the map, tightening the pattern Starline has been sketching in other people's engines.  \n\nSo far, the trail runs through a forgotten datapad in backcountry rock, a buried analyst station full of censored telemetry, and whispers of a missing settler convoy whose last jumps echo the same wrong angles. Taken together, the numbers all tilt toward a second, unseen mass casting its shadow across every chart he has ever touched.
zh: 在这里的安静轨道上，贴着黑暗嗡鸣的那东西与其说是信标，不如说是交通航道上一道伤疤，一种船只如何选择跃迁时缓慢而刻意的扭结。它本不该存在于离定居太空这么近的地方；有人一层层地把航线绕着它掰弯，直到船长们开始跟随一条他们看不见的曲线。任其自生自灭，它会继续教引擎朝星图上同一个盲角倾斜，收紧"星线"在别人的引擎里一直在勾勒的模式。  \n\n目前为止，线索穿过乡间岩石上一块被遗忘的数据板、一座塞满被审查遥测的被埋分析站，以及关于一支失踪定居者车队的低语——它的最后几次跃迁回响着同样错误的夹角。合在一起看，这些数字全都倾向第二个看不见的质量体，它的阴影投在他碰过的每一张星图上。

#en: Gagarin is where the numbers first slipped their leash, even if nobody logged it that way. In the rusted shadows of the agro annex and the noise of loaders on the strip, someone threaded a new path into existing routes, a quiet edit that turned routine grain into a message only a careful reader could catch. Whatever was installed here touches every cargo link she has used since; without that pattern, everything you have heard about failed inspections and miracle harvests stays as bar talk and burned terminals. From what little survives, you can piece together that anonymous survey logs on a forgotten rock mentioned recall orders that never came, inspectors here muttered about shipments moving too fast for comfort, and somewhere between those two points, a single routing fragment keeps repeating like a nervous tick in the system.
zh: 加加林星，就是那些数字第一次挣脱缰绳的地方，尽管没人那样记录过。在农业附属区锈蚀的阴影与装卸带的噪声中，有人把一条新路径穿进现有航线，一次安静的编辑，把例行的谷物变成只有细心读者才能捕捉到的信息。安装在这里的东西触及她此后用过的每一条货运链路；没有那个模式，你听到的关于失败检查与奇迹收成的所有说法，就都只是酒吧闲谈与烧坏的终端。从残存下来的极少东西里，你能拼出：某块被遗忘岩石上的匿名勘探日志提到从未到来的召回令，这里的检查员嘟囔着货运快得令人不安，而在这两点之间的某处，一段单一的航线路由碎片像系统里一根紧张的抽搐一样反复出现。

#en: Ryujin's tower in Neon is where numbers stop being theory and start buying silence; whatever was carved out of their internal ledgers will show which clients paid for routes that just happened to skirt disaster, and which accidents were never accidents at all. The trail of altered vectors disappears into their accounting stacks, where navigation experiments are buried as research write-offs and side-channel contracts, and if anything links corporate money to those ghost corrections, it will be here, half-redacted and mislabeled. So far, all anyone agrees on is this much: a burned slate on a forgotten relay showed the first pattern, freight captains in frontier bars swore the same unseen hand nudged their jumps, and a jittery analyst in New Atlantis confirmed that whole folders of anomaly data vanished the moment her name came up.
zh: 霓虹城的龙神大楼，是数字不再是理论、而开始买得起沉默的地方；从他们内部账册里挖出的任何东西，都会显示哪些客户为"恰好擦过灾难"的航线付了钱、哪些事故根本不是事故。被改动向量的线索消失进他们的会计堆里——导航实验被当作研究注销与侧信道合同埋起来；而若说有任何东西把公司的钱与那些幽灵修正系在一起，它就会在这里，半涂黑、标签错乱。目前为止，所有人唯一一致认同的只有这些：一块被遗忘中继上烧毁的数据板显示了第一个模式，边境酒吧里的货船船长发誓同一只无形之手推动了他们的跃迁，而新亚特兰蒂斯城一名神经紧张的分析员确认，整批整批的异常数据在她名字被提起的那一刻就消失了。

#en: The old relay station hangs over the dead plain like a rusted crown, its dishes still clawing at the sky long after the UC crossed it off their maps. Out here the noise floor is low, clean enough for one mind to bend every beacon and emergency channel in a half-dozen systems. This is where years of quiet rerouting, falsified distress calls, and engineered "ghost rescues" converge into a single live grid, its cores running hot with civilian traffic that does not know who is holding the switch. If the work is cut anywhere else, it heals; sever it here, and the pattern breaks. From the first scorched dataslate on that nameless rock to the gutted drone lab and the bunker tech clutching stolen sensor traces, every lead has pointed to one architect, one hidden hand inside the emergency network, drawing everything toward this silent node.
zh: 那座旧中继站像一顶锈蚀的王冠悬在死寂平原之上，它的天线在联殖把它从星图上划掉很久之后仍在抓挠天空。在这外面，本底噪声很低，干净到足以让一个头脑弯折半打星系里的每一座信标与紧急频道。这里正是多年安静改道、伪造遇险呼叫与精心设计的"幽灵救援"汇聚成一张活网格的地方，它的核心为那些不知道谁握着开关的民用交通而发烫。若在别处切断这项工作，它会自愈；在这里切断它，模式就断了。从那块无名岩石上第一块烧焦的数据板，到被掏空的无人机实验室与紧抱偷来传感器痕迹的掩体技师，每一条线索都指向同一位设计者、同一只藏在应急网络里的手，把一切引向这座沉默的节点。

#en: The hut squats alone against the wind-scoured ridge, its sensor masts half-frozen, lenses crusted with dust and ice. Out here, nobody bothers to clean up after a storm, or after a fugitive; they just let the monitors keep quietly recording heat and motion until the buffers fill and overwrite. This is the one place where the ground itself will have told the truth about who crossed it, how fast they moved, what they were running from or toward, long after the locals started shrugging and claiming they "did not see much that night." So far the trail is built on those kinds of omissions: a remote station that logged a spike and filed it under "atmospherics," a patrol pilot who swore his scopes glitched, a frontier sheriff who remembered a stranger's ship but not the direction it left, each testimony neat where it should have been messy.
zh: 那座小屋孤零零地蹲在风蚀山脊旁，它的传感器桅杆半冻着，镜头结满尘土与冰。在这外面，没人在风暴过后清理现场，也没人在逃犯过后清理；他们只是让监测器继续悄悄记录热量与动静，直到缓冲区满、自行覆写。这是唯一一处地面本身会说出真相的地方——谁曾穿越它、移动得多快、在躲开什么或奔向什么，而这一切都远在当地人开始耸肩声称"那晚没看见什么"之后。目前为止，这条线索正是建立在那样一些省略上：一座记录了尖峰却把它归进"大气现象"的远程星际站、一名发誓自己示波器出故障的巡逻飞行员、一名记得陌生人的船却记不得它离开方向的边境治安官——每一份证词都在本该凌乱的地方显得过分整洁。

#en: The Freestar field command trailer is the only place where someone outside UC bothered to map the same warped routes you have been chasing, scribbled between patrol schedules and casualty tallies. Out here, away from polished briefing rooms, a deputy had time to notice which convoys kept vanishing after buying discount guidance, and which coordinates no one wanted to write into official reports. The air inside hums with generator noise and unasked questions; the few Rangers still working the board go quiet when traffic anomalies are mentioned, suddenly busy with anything that does not involve meeting your eyes. So far, the trail runs from a drifting buoy packed with falsified vectors to dockside manifests showing identical edits, all pointing toward a single hand quietly selling bad directions to anyone desperate enough to trust them.
zh: 自由星系联盟战地指挥拖车，是唯一一个联殖之外的人费心绘制过你一直在追的同样扭曲航线的地方，涂写在巡逻日程与伤亡统计之间。在这外面，远离光鲜的简报室，一名副警长有时间注意到：哪些车队在买了打折导航后接连消失、哪些坐标没人愿意写进官方报告。里面的空气因发电机噪声与未问出口的问题而嗡鸣；仍在板前工作的少数游骑兵一提到交通异常就沉默下来，突然忙于任何不必与你对视的事。目前为止，线索从一枚塞满伪造向量的漂移浮标，延伸到显示相同编辑的码头舱单，全都指向一只悄悄把错误方向卖给任何绝望到愿意相信之人的手。

#en: If she ever left a fingerprint anywhere, it would be here, buried beneath Aurora haze and music that makes your bones vibrate. The lounge sits at the crossroads of half the Settled Systems; captains, smugglers, and data-fixers drift through with pockets full of half-scrubbed logs and stories they only tell when they think no one important is listening. Routing anomalies become bar talk, emergency advisories become drinking jokes, and the same odd timing in the lanes gets mentioned just enough to prove it is not coincidence anymore. So far I have a discarded slate from a forgotten rock, jittery rumors traded over Neon cocktails, and echoes in SysDef telemetry; taken together they show how an old shuttle disaster and a string of "lucky" saves bent people and traffic just enough to land me at this bar, listening for a ghost in the noise.
zh: 若说她曾在任何地方留下过指纹，那就会在这里，埋在极光的雾气与让你骨头共振的音乐之下。这家酒廊坐落在半个定居星系的十字路口；船长、走私者与数据掮客来来去去，口袋里塞满半擦除的日志与他们只在以为没有要紧人在听时才讲的故事。路由异常变成酒吧闲谈，紧急通告变成下酒笑话，而航道上同样古怪的时机被提起的次数刚好足以证明它不再是巧合。目前为止，我有一块来自被遗忘岩石的被丢弃数据板、在霓虹城鸡尾酒中交易的紧张传闻，以及星防队遥测里的回声；合在一起，它们显示出一起旧穿梭机空难与一连串"幸运"救援如何把人与交通掰得刚好足以把我带到这家酒吧，在噪声里听一个幽灵。

#en: Neon's underbelly holds on to things time should have shaken loose; debts, bodies, and secrets all settle in the dripping steel and humming conduits beneath the lights. Vector chose this place precisely because nothing leaves here quickly, not cargo, not rumors, not witnesses. Down in the wet market shadows she can buy fuel, scrub transponders, and disappear experimental samples into a biotech gray zone that answers to no law but profit. Every false trail she and Rourke laid, every redirected shipment and vanished homestead, has been angling them toward this bolt-hole beneath the city that never forgets what it swallows. Earlier we found the first crooked data at that lonely outpost, then strange telemetry in high orbit, and finally a courier's gutted hold; together they sketched one truth, that their route always bent back toward Neon.
zh: 霓虹城的下腹会留住时间本应摇松的东西；债务、尸体与秘密都在灯光下滴水的钢铁与嗡鸣的导管里沉降下来。"向量"选中这地方，恰恰是因为这里没有东西会很快离开——货物不会、传闻不会、证人也不会。在湿货市场的阴影里，她可以买燃料、擦净应答器，并把实验样本消失进一个只认利润、不认任何法律的生物技术灰色地带。她和鲁尔克布下的每一条假痕迹、每一次被改道的货运与每一个消失的农庄，都一直把他们引向这座城市下方那个从不忘掉自己吞下过什么的藏身洞。早先我们在那座孤独前哨发现了第一批歪斜数据，然后是高轨道上的古怪遥测，最后是一艘信使船被掏空的货舱；合在一起，它们勾勒出一个真相：他们的航线总是弯回霓虹城。

#en: The combat hulk hanging dead in space is more than wreckage; it is where financial models and weapons doctrine were spliced together, then abandoned when the operators realized the currents they were testing ran deeper than any patrol route. Only here, in the frozen CIC of this UC SysDef vessel, do the cross-linked transfer logs and engagement priorities still lie side by side, untouched by GalBank censors or naval tribunals, a record of how Ledger's work was folded into war games by officers who walked away before understanding what they had set in motion. Back in Neon's shadows, ledgers and whispered rumors first tied her numbers to criminal traffic; now the trail has climbed from undercity lockers to a lost warship, and the pattern looks less like a heist and more like someone teaching the Settled Systems how to weaponize a bank run.
zh: 那具死寂地悬在太空中的战斗船壳不只是残骸；它是"金融模型与武器学说被拼接在一起、随后在操作者意识到他们测试的暗流比任何巡逻航线都更深时被弃置"的地方。只有在这里、在这艘联殖星防队舰船的冻结指挥中心里，交叉关联的转账日志与交战优先级才仍并排躺着，未被盖尔银行审查员或海军法庭碰过——一份记录，记录着军官们如何把"账本"的工作折进战争演习，而他们还没来得及理解自己启动了什么都已转身离开。在霓虹城的阴影里，账册与低语传闻最初把她的数字与犯罪交通系在一起；如今线索从下城储物柜爬上一艘失落的军舰，而这个模式看起来不再像一次盗窃，更像有人在教定居星系如何把"挤兑银行"武器化。

#en: Survey buoys do not usually sit this far off the standard lanes, and they do not usually whisper coordinates that disagree with every official chart by the same precise margin. Whatever has been nudging jump data sideways chose this empty orbit on purpose; adjust trajectories here and whole trade routes, patrol paths, and escape vectors drift without anyone noticing until it is too late. Letting that anchor point remain hidden means every later trace of the target's movements will be built on warped space. Up to now the trail has been small, crooked signatures on forgotten worlds, a scratched dataslate in the dust, a beacon whose heartbeat never matched its traffic, and a dead SysDef hull whose own logs argued with themselves, all hinting that someone has been editing both paths and fates from the shadows for longer than anyone realized.
zh: 勘探浮标通常不会离标准航道这么远，也通常不会低语着与每一张官方星图都以同样精确幅度不符的坐标。一直在把跃迁数据往侧面推的东西，是刻意选中这条空荡轨道；在这里调整轨迹，整条贸易航线、巡逻路径与逃生向量都会漂移，而没人察觉到，直到为时已晚。让那个锚点继续隐藏，意味着之后对目标行踪的每一条追踪都会建在扭曲的太空上。目前为止，这条线索是那些被遗忘世界上的小小歪斜签名、尘土里一块被划花的数据板、一座心跳从未与自身交通相符的信标，以及一具与自己日志争吵的死掉星防队船壳，全都暗示有人从阴影里同时编辑路径与命运，时间比任何人意识到的都久。

#en: The abandoned listening post still remembers every whisper the UC tried to bury; its dishes sit crooked under a dead sky, but the racks below hum just enough to prove someone repurposed its ears. Hotel Hardstrike did not set up here for nostalgia they are guarding whatever beacon data survived deletion, the off-angle pings that show where lanes were bent, not broken. Whoever sold them this watch claims the contract came from a friend of a friend, no names attached, every story passed down secondhand until truth and cover blend. So far the trail runs like this a ghost relay spilling corrupted timings, freight captains in frontier dives swearing the same unseen hand nudged their jumps, a nervous analyst in New Atlantis watching anomaly folders vanish, then corporate ledgers in Neon quietly acknowledging routes no one will admit authorizing.
zh: 那座废弃听音哨仍记得联殖试图埋葬的每一句低语；它的天线盘在死寂天空下歪斜着，可下面的机架嗡鸣得刚好足以证明有人改用了它的耳朵。"硬击旅社"扎在这里不是为了怀旧——他们守着删除后残存的信标数据，那些显示航道被掰弯、而非被折断的偏角脉冲。把这份看守卖给他们的人声称合同来自"朋友的朋友"，不具名，每个说法都二手传递，直到真相与掩护混成一体。目前为止，线索是这样的：一座喷吐损坏时序的幽灵中继、边境廉价酒馆里的货船船长发誓同一只无形之手推动了他们的跃迁、新亚特兰蒂斯城一名神经紧张的分析员看着异常文件夹消失，然后是霓虹城的公司账册悄悄承认了没人愿意承认自己批准过的航线。

#en: The relay was never meant to matter; just another aging node left to hum along on stale firmware at the edge of anyone's responsibility. That is exactly why someone chose it. One forgotten maintenance window, one unsupervised access change, and the traffic through this place started to warp: distress calls stretched, ship IDs misfiled, routes quietly bent away from prying eyes. The Starbreak Salvors squatting in its corridors think they are guarding a lucky glitch in the network, a tap on unclaimed signals, but whatever was nudged here has been snowballing for years. All anyone really knows so far is that a discarded dataslate in a remote landing site hinted at closed claims on missing ships, and word from station bars says those same registry numbers keep reappearing in the kind of off-ledger salvage auctions that should not exist at all.
zh: 那座中继本不该有任何意义；不过是又一个陈旧节点，靠过期固件在"谁都管不着"的边缘嗡鸣。这正是有人选中它的原因。一次被遗忘的维护窗口、一次无人监督的权限变更，经过此地的交通就开始扭曲：遇险呼叫被拉长、船只 ID 被错档、航线被悄悄掰离窥探的眼睛。蹲在它走廊里的"破星打捞队"以为自己在守着网络里一处幸运的小故障、一个搭上无主信号的便宜，可这里被推过的东西已经滚雪球般积累多年。所有人目前真正知道的只有：某处偏远着陆点一块被丢弃的数据板暗示了失踪船只上被结清的赔偿，而星际站酒吧里的消息说，那些同样的登记号不断出现在本不该存在的账外打捞拍卖里。

#en: This tower is where theory quietly becomes hardware, where someone's off-the-record experiment slipped past review and kept being funded because shutting it down would mean admitting it ever existed. Whatever Rourke is shaping out on the fringes started with samples and figures like these, and Vector will keep finding safe landing pads as long as the data backing their work remains buried in institutions that refuse to own their mistakes. Fractured Phalanx holding the doors suggests a small security favor grew into a permanent shadow contract, another oversight no one wanted to untangle. So far the trail runs from that isolated homestead, to the crooked beacon in high orbit, to the gutted courier and its doctored routes, then down into Neon's lower decks, each step pointing toward the same pattern of quiet approvals and redirected research.
zh: 这座塔，是理论悄悄变成硬件的地方，是某人的不记录在案实验溜过审查、而继续获得经费——因为关停它就意味着承认它存在过——的地方。鲁尔克在边境上正在塑形的东西，就是从这样的样本与数字开始的；而只要支撑他们工作的数据仍埋在拒绝认领自己错误的机构里，"向量"就会不断找到安全的落脚点。把守大门的破碎方阵说明，一次小小的安保人情长成了一份永久的影子合同，又一处没人愿意理清的疏忽。目前为止，线索从那座与世隔绝的农庄，到高轨道上歪斜的信标，到被掏空的信使船及其被做手脚的航线，再向下钻进霓虹城的下层甲板，每一步都指向同一种安静批准与改道研究的模式。

#en: This forgotten Colony War barracks is where her story always bends back a place built for breaking bodies and patching them just enough to send them out again. The rusted cots and dead med scanners are more than ruins to her; they are familiar instruments, now wired into a final lab where she can refine the same stimulants and counter-chems that slipped from field improvisations into black contracts and frontier dependence. Here, away from oversight, she can stabilize a last generation of formulas and sever any trail that points back to the veterans and settlers relying on her work. The courier stripped in deep space, the doctored manifests, the discreet interventions traced through orbital medicine all left faint patterns in routing codes and dosage signatures that narrow, step by step, to this one bunker where Catalyst has chosen to stand.
zh: 这座被遗忘的殖民地大战军营，是她的故事总是拐回的地方——一座为折断躯体、再把他们修补到刚好够用、又送出去而建的设施。那些锈蚀的床铺与死掉的医疗扫描仪对她而言不只是废墟；它们是熟悉的器械，如今接进了最后一座实验室——她可以在那里精炼那些从战地临时应变溜进黑合同与边境依赖的同款兴奋剂与对抗药剂。在这里，远离监督，她能稳定最后一代配方，并切断任何指回那些依赖她工作的老兵与定居者的痕迹。深空中被剥光的信使船、被做手脚的舱单、经由轨道医疗追溯到的谨慎干预，都在航线路由代码与剂量签名里留下了淡淡的模式，一步步收窄到这座掩体——"催化剂"选择站定的地方。

#en: The deserted UC listening post sits at the exact hinge of the traffic web Vector has been bending, an old ear left humming on the edge of nowhere while newer arrays took the spotlight. Its consoles still remember what passed through them, even after the crews rotated out and the inspections stopped paying attention; familiarity bred complacency, and in that blind spot he buried the patterns that point straight to him. Now a local gang has sprawled through the corridors, more interested in cover and contraband than in the half-wiped logs under their boots, giving his secrets a layer of noisy, human camouflage. All I know walking in is this: an orbital relay burned with falsified routes, dockside records showed matching edits in freight manifests, and the same signature rode both, hiding in the static while everyone called it a harmless glitch.
zh: 那座废弃的联殖听音哨，恰好坐落在"向量"一直在掰弯的交通网铰链上，一只被留在天涯之外嗡鸣的旧耳朵，而更新的阵列抢走了聚光灯。它的控制台仍记得穿过它们的东西，即便船员轮岗离开、检查也不再留意；熟悉养出了自满，而在那个盲点里，他埋下了直接指向自己的模式。如今一伙当地帮派在走廊里蔓延开来，比起他们靴子底下那些半擦除的日志，他们更在意掩护与违禁品——这给他的秘密盖上了一层喧闹的人形伪装。我入场时只确定这些：一座轨道中继被烧上了伪造航线，码头记录显示货运舱单里有相同的编辑，而同一道签名骑着两者，藏在静电里，而所有人都说它不过是无害的小故障。
